wine.ingredientsDescription: Pasirinkite sudedamąsias dalis iš vyno sudedamųjų dalių sąrašo arba pridėkite pasirinktinius. Rikiuokite pagal kiekį (didžiausias pirmas).

wine.sortIngredientsDescription: Sudedamųjų dalių sąrašas turėtų būti surikiuotas nuo didžiausio iki mažiausio kiekio. Kiekių mažesnių nei 0,1 g/100 ml nereikia rikiuoti.

wine.selectIngredientsTitle: Pasirinkite vyno sudedamąsias dalis iš sąrašo
wine.recyclingDescription: Pasirinkite medžiagas, naudojamas jūsų vyno pakuotei.
wine.recyclingNote: Patikrinkite vietinius perdirbimo nurodymus. Atskirkite komponentus ir tinkamai juos pašalinkite.
wine.negligibleAmounts: Sudėtyje yra nereikšmingi kiekiai riebalų, sočiųjų riebalų rūgščių, baltymų ir druskos.

hints.productName: Komercinis jūsų vyno pavadinimas, kaip nurodyta etiketėje.
hints.productNameTooltip: Tai oficialus produkto pavadinimas, matomas vartotojams. Turi tiksliai atitikti tai, kas atspausdinta etiketėje.
hints.grapeVariety: Vynuogių rūšis(-ys), naudota(-os) šiam vynui gaminti.
hints.grapeVarietyTooltip: Nurodykite vynuogių veisles (pvz., Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Chardonnay). Mišiniams galite nurodyti kelias veisles. ES teisės aktų reikalavimas.
hints.vintageTooltip: Derlius nurodo metų derlių. Naudokite 'NV' (Non-Vintage) vynams, sumaišytiems iš kelių metų, dažna šampanui.
hints.volumeTooltip: Standartiniai buteliai yra 750 ml. Kiti dažni dydžiai: 375 ml (pusė butelio), 1,5 L (Magnum), 3 L (Double Magnum).
hints.countryTooltip: Šalis, kurioje vynuogės buvo auginamos ir vynas pagamintas. Teisinis reikalavimas vynui, parduodamam ES.
hints.regionTooltip: Geografinė vietovė šalyje, kurioje vynas buvo pagamintas (pvz., Bordo, Toskana).
hints.denomination: Oficiali kokybės klasifikacija arba saugoma kilmė.
hints.denominationTooltip: Saugomos nuorodos, tokios kaip AOC, AOP, DOC, DOCG arba IGP. Šie ES saugomi terminai garantuoja specifinių reikalavimų atitiktį.
hints.sugarClassificationTooltip: Putojančiam vynui: Brut Nature (0-3 g/L), Extra Brut (0-6 g/L), Brut (0-12 g/L), Extra Dry (12-17 g/L), Dry/Sec (17-32 g/L), Demi-Sec (32-50 g/L), Doux (50+ g/L).
hints.producerNameTooltip: Teisinis gamintojo, sodybos ar vyninės pavadinimas. Privalomas duomuo vyno etiketėse.
hints.bottlerInfoTooltip: ES teisė reikalauja nurodyti, kas pilstė vyną ir jo adresą.
hints.alcoholPercentTooltip: Alkoholio procentinė dalis vyne. ES teisė reikalauja nurodyti etiketėje su ±0,5 % tolerancija.
hints.residualSugarTooltip: Natūralaus vynuogių cukraus kiekis (g/L), kuris nebuvo paverstas alkoholiu fermentacijos metu. Sausi vynai paprastai turi mažiau nei 4 g/L.
hints.totalAcidity: Bendras rūgščių kiekis, išreikštas vyno rūgštimi.
hints.totalAcidityTooltip: Bendrasis rūgštingumas matuojamas g/L kaip vyno rūgšties (C₄H₆O₆) ekvivalentas. Tipinės vertės: 4–9 g/L.
hints.glycerineTooltip: Glicerinas yra natūralus alkoholinės fermentacijos šalutinis produktas, prisidedantis prie vyno kūno ir skonio. Tipinės vertės: 4–15 g/L.
hints.calculatedValuesTooltip: Maistinės vertės automatiškai apskaičiuojamos iš alkoholio, cukraus, rūgštingumo ir glicerino pagal ES standartines formules. Pažymėkite 'Rankinis' norint įvesti savo laboratorinius duomenis.
hints.energyTooltip: Energinė vertė apskaičiuota iš alkoholio (7 kcal/g), cukraus (4 kcal/g) ir glicerino (2,4 kcal/g).
hints.carbohydratesTooltip: Bendri angliavandeniai apskaičiuojami kaip likutinio cukraus ir vyno rūgšties kiekio 100 ml suma.
hints.sugarNutritionTooltip: Cukraus vertė maistingumo deklaracijoje, apskaičiuota iš likutinio cukraus 100 ml.
hints.smallQuantitiesHint: Vynas natūraliai turi labai mažus šių maistinių medžiagų kiekius. Palikite 0, nebent laboratorinė analizė rodo kitaip.
hints.smallQuantitiesTooltip: ES reglamentas 1169/2011 leidžia nurodyti 'Sudėtyje yra nereikšmingi kiekiai' maistinėms medžiagoms, esančioms labai mažais kiekiais.
hints.electronicLabelHint: Neprivalomi duomenys, rodomi šalia privalomos maistinės informacijos.
hints.electronicLabelTooltip: Be privalomos maistingumo deklaracijos galite pasirinktinai rodyti papildomus analitinius duomenis, tokius kaip alkoholis %, likutinis cukrus ar rūgštingumas.
hints.displaySettingsHint: Valdykite papildomus elementus, rodomus viešajame paso puslapyje.

disclaimer.title: Žaislų DPP – atitikties atsakomybės apribojimas
disclaimer.body: Tikslus ES skaitmeninio gaminio paso duomenų modelis ir API specifikacijos žaislams dar nėra nustatytos ir tikimasi, kad jos bus apibrėžtos įgyvendinimo akte, kuris turi būti priimtas iki 2026 m. pabaigos. Šis įrankis yra pirmoji versija, pagrįsta Reglamentu (ES) 2025/2509, ir neturėtų būti laikomas galutine teisine konsultacija.

consent.title: Reklamos slapukai
consent.description: Naudojame reklamos slapukus, kad įvertintume savo skelbimų veiksmingumą. Jie įrašomi tik jums sutikus.

responsible_operators.title: Who is responsible
responsible_operators.description: Manufacturer, importer and EU responsible person, kept as three separate parties

materials.title: Materials and Composition
materials.description: Mandatory fibre content labelling per EU Regulation 1007/2011

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Which certifications this item holds, and how to verify each claim.

supply_chain.title: Supply Chain Journey
supply_chain.description: Country of each production stage plus Tier 1 factory and audit status

environment.title: Environmental Footprint
environment.description: Environmental figures with a stated calculation method

durability.title: Durability and Testing
durability.description: Measured durability results. The expected textile delegated act under ESPR is anticipated to focus on durability metrics, so record real test results rather than subjective scores.

circularity.title: Circularity and End of Life
circularity.description: Care, repair, take-back and recyclability information

disposition.title: Disposition Record
disposition.description: Supports the ESPR ban on destroying unsold consumer goods, which applies to large companies from 19 July 2026 and requires record-keeping and disclosure

green_claims.title: Green Claims Substantiation
green_claims.description: Supports the Empowering Consumers Directive (EU) 2024/825, which applies from 27 September 2026

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Anti-counterfeit features linked to this item

show_advanced_fields.label: Show all fields (certifications detail, Tier 1 factory and audit status, environmental footprint, durability testing, extended circularity)
show_advanced_fields.help: Most brands only need the fields below. Turn this on if you have lab test results, LCA data, or detailed supply-chain traceability to record.

gtin.label: GTIN / EAN
gtin.help: Trade item number identifying the SKU.

item_unique_identifier.label: Per-item Unique Identifier
item_unique_identifier.help: Identifies this individual physical item, not the SKU. Per-item identifiers are what enable resale, ownership transfer and authentication over the product lifetime.
item_unique_identifier.warn: Open Label does not assign this identifier for you. Brands should build their own per-item identification system — e.g. serialized RFID/NFC tags, a production-line numbering scheme, or an existing ERP serial — and enter that value here.

style_reference.label: Style / Model Reference
style_reference.help: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 (GPSR) requires a product identifier of type, batch or serial number alongside the manufacturer name and address. This is the identifier for the product type/batch — it is not a substitute for the per-item identifier above.

product_weight_grams.label: Product Weight (grams)
product_weight_grams.help: Net weight of the item, used for shipping and material-intensity reporting.

manufacturer_legal_name.label: Manufacturer legal name
manufacturer_legal_name.help: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 (GPSR) requires the manufacturer's name, postal address and electronic address to be given on the product or its packaging.

manufacturer_non_eu.label: Is the manufacturer established outside the EU?

importer_legal_name.label: Importer legal name
importer_legal_name.help: When the manufacturer is established outside the EU, the importer's name, postal address and electronic address must also be given.

eu_operator_name.label: EU responsible person — legal name
eu_operator_name.help: The EU responsible person under Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 Article 4 is a separate role from the manufacturer and the importer, even when the same company performs more than one of them.

eu_operator_address.label: EU responsible person — address
eu_operator_address.placeholder: Registered address inside the European Union

contains_animal_parts.label: Contains non-textile parts of animal origin
contains_animal_parts.help: EU Regulation 1007/2011 requires this to be stated on the label when a product contains non-textile parts of animal origin, such as leather patches, fur trim, horn or bone buttons.

animal_parts_details.label: Which parts, and from which animal
animal_parts_details.placeholder: e.g., Leather elbow patches (bovine); horn buttons (buffalo)

component_composition.label: Component-level Composition
component_composition.help: Declare outer shell, lining and trims separately so each component can be assessed for recycling.
component_composition.placeholder:
Outer shell: 100% Cotton
Lining: 100% Viscose
Trims: Polyester zip, brass buttons

recycled_pre_consumer_percentage.label: Pre-consumer Recycled Content (%)
recycled_pre_consumer_percentage.help: Production waste reclaimed before reaching a consumer.

recycled_post_consumer_percentage.label: Post-consumer Recycled Content (%)
recycled_post_consumer_percentage.help: Material recovered from products that reached end users.

microplastic_shedding.label: Contains synthetic fibres that shed microplastics?
microplastic_shedding.help: The French AGEC law requires informing consumers when a garment releases microplastic fibres during washing.

svhc_declared.label: REACH / SVHC substances present above 0.1% w/w?
svhc_declared.help: Substances of Very High Concern per Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 (REACH).

svhc_details.label: SVHC Substance Details
svhc_details.placeholder: Substance name, CAS number, concentration and component

pfas_present.label: Does this product contain intentionally added PFAS?
pfas_present.help: France prohibits PFAS in clothing, footwear and waterproofing agents from 1 January 2026 under Law 2025-188. PFAS are commonly found in durable water repellent (DWR) finishes.
pfas_present.warn: Placing apparel containing intentionally added PFAS on the French market is prohibited from 1 January 2026 under Law 2025-188. An "Unknown" answer must be resolved with the supplier before selling in France.

pfas_details.label: Which components and which substances
pfas_details.placeholder: e.g., DWR finish on outer shell — PFHxA

certificate_references.label: Certificate References
certificate_references.help: From 27 September 2026, Directive (EU) 2024/825 requires a sustainability label to be based on a certification scheme or established by a public authority. Leave blank if no certifications are held above.
certificate_references.placeholder:
One per line, e.g.
GOTS — CU 123456 GOTS — expires 2027-06-30
OEKO-TEX — 21.HTR.12345 — expires 2027-01-15

country_fibre_production.label: Country of Fibre Production
country_fibre_production.placeholder: Where the fibre was grown or produced

country_of_origin.label: Country of Making-up / Assembly
country_of_origin.help: The stage declared as country of origin on the label.

audit_certificate_file.label: Audit Certificate (upload)
audit_certificate_file.help: Held for your internal records — never published on the public passport.

footprint_method.label: Calculation Method
footprint_method.help: A figure without a stated calculation method is not a substantiated claim under the Empowering Consumers Directive.

lca_report_file.label: Supporting LCA Report (upload)
lca_report_file.help: Held for your internal records — never published on the public passport.

dimensional_stability.label: Dimensional Stability After Washing Result
dimensional_stability.help: Test standard: ISO 6330 with ISO 5077 measurement.

test_report_file.label: Test Report (upload)
test_report_file.help: Held for your internal records — never published on the public passport.

spare_trims_available.label: Spare trims available for repair?
spare_trims_available.help: Buttons, zips, cords and other replaceable components.

take_back_scheme_epr.label: Take-back Scheme Name and EPR Registration Numbers per Market
take_back_scheme_epr.help: Extended Producer Responsibility registration numbers differ per member state, so list one line per market.

disassembly_notes.label: Disassembly Notes
disassembly_notes.placeholder: How to separate the outer shell, lining, trims and hardware for recycling

disposition_reason_code.label: Destruction Reason Code
disposition_reason_code.warn: Destruction of unsold apparel by large companies is restricted from 19 July 2026 under the ESPR and requires record-keeping and public disclosure.

disposition_notes.label: Disposition Notes
disposition_notes.placeholder: Quantity, handling route and any competent authority reference

environmental_claims.label: Environmental Claims Made on Product or Packaging
environmental_claims.placeholder: e.g., "Made with 50% post-consumer recycled polyester (GRS certified)"

claims_evidence_reference.label: Substantiation Evidence Reference
claims_evidence_reference.placeholder: Study, certificate or verification body reference for each claim

claims_evidence_file.label: Substantiation Evidence (upload)
claims_evidence_file.help: Held for your internal records — never published on the public passport.

claims_avoid_generic_terms.label: Claims avoid generic environmental terms?
claims_avoid_generic_terms.help: Generic claims such as "eco-friendly", "conscious" and "carbon neutral via offsetting" are prohibited from 27 September 2026.

authentication_feature_present.label: Authentication feature present?
authentication_feature_present.help: Apparel is among the most counterfeited product categories in the EU, so item-level authentication materially protects the brand and the buyer.

careSymbols.dry_clean_petroleum: Professional dry clean, petroleum solvent only

dispositionReason.donation_refused: Donation refused after asking three social economy organisations
dispositionReason.unlawful_product: Product turned out to be unlawful
